description: Retrieve a VirusTotal collection by ID. Collections represent threat actors, malware families, campaigns, intel reports, and curated IOC sets — often referenced from the related_threat_actors and collections relationships on other tools. Optionally include relationships (files, urls, domains, ip_addresses, references, threat_actors, related_collections, related_references, comments, owner, autogenerated_graphs) to fetch member IOCs in the same call.

id.description: Collection ID (e.g. a threat-actor, malware family, campaign, or report identifier returned from a relationship lookup)

relationships.description: Optional list of relationships to include in the response

name: get_collection
